   85 #===============================================================================
   86 # Fails unless user has already used all other moves it knows. (Last Resort)
   87 #===============================================================================
   88 class Battle::Move::FailsIfUserHasUnusedMove < Battle::Move
   89   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
   90     hasThisMove = false
   91     hasOtherMoves = false
   92     hasUnusedMoves = false
   93     user.eachMove do |m|
   94       hasThisMove    = true if m.id == @id
   95       hasOtherMoves  = true if m.id != @id
   96       hasUnusedMoves = true if m.id != @id && !user.movesUsed.include?(m.id)
   97     end
   98     if !hasThisMove || !hasOtherMoves || hasUnusedMoves
   99       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  100       return true
  101     end
  102     return false
  103   end
  104 end

  457 #===============================================================================
  458 # All effects that apply to one side of the field are swapped to the opposite
  459 # side. (Court Change)
  460 #===============================================================================
  461 class Battle::Move::SwapSideEffects < Battle::Move
  462   attr_reader :number_effects, :boolean_effects
  463 
  464   def initialize(battle, move)
  465     super
  466     @number_effects = [
  467       PBEffects::AuroraVeil,
  468       PBEffects::LightScreen,
  469       PBEffects::Mist,
  470       PBEffects::Rainbow,
  471       PBEffects::Reflect,
  472       PBEffects::Safeguard,
  473       PBEffects::SeaOfFire,
  474       PBEffects::Spikes,
  475       PBEffects::Swamp,
  476       PBEffects::Tailwind,
  477       PBEffects::ToxicSpikes
  478     ]
  479     @boolean_effects = [
  480       PBEffects::StealthRock,
  481       PBEffects::StickyWeb
  482     ]
  483   end
  484 
  485   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  486     has_effect = false
  487     2.times do |side|
  488       effects = @battle.sides[side].effects
  489       @number_effects.each do |e|
  490         next if effects[e] == 0
  491         has_effect = true
  492         break
  493       end
  494       break if has_effect
  495       @boolean_effects.each do |e|
  496         next if !effects[e]
  497         has_effect = true
  498         break
  499       end
  500       break if has_effect
  501     end
  502     if !has_effect
  503       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
  504       return true
  505     end
  506     return false
  507   end
  508 
  509   def pbEffectGeneral(user)
  510     side0 = @battle.sides[0]
  511     side1 = @battle.sides[1]
  512     @number_effects.each do |e|
  513       side0.effects[e], side1.effects[e] = side1.effects[e], side0.effects[e]
  514     end
  515     @boolean_effects.each do |e|
  516       side0.effects[e], side1.effects[e] = side1.effects[e], side0.effects[e]
  517     end
  518     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} swapped the battle effects affecting each side of the field!", user.pbThis))
  519   end
  520 end

  522 #===============================================================================
  523 # User turns 1/4 of max HP into a substitute. (Substitute)
  524 #===============================================================================
  525 class Battle::Move::UserMakeSubstitute < Battle::Move
  526   def canSnatch?; return true; end

  530       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} already has a substitute!", user.pbThis))

  533     @subLife = [user.totalhp / 4, 1].max

  547     user.effects[PBEffects::Trapping]     = 0

  554 #===============================================================================
  555 # Removes trapping moves, entry hazards and Leech Seed on user/user's side.
  556 # Raises user's Speed by 1 stage (Gen 8+). (Rapid Spin)
  557 #===============================================================================
  558 class Battle::Move::RemoveUserBindingAndEntryHazards < Battle::Move::StatUpMove
  559   def initialize(battle, move)
  560     super
  561     @statUp = [:SPEED, 1]
  562   end
  563 
  564   def pbEffectAfterAllHits(user, target)
  565     return if user.fainted? || target.damageState.unaffected
  566     if user.effects[PBEffects::Trapping] > 0
  567       trapMove = GameData::Move.get(user.effects[PBEffects::TrappingMove]).name
  568       trapUser = @battle.battlers[user.effects[PBEffects::TrappingUser]]
  569       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} got free of {2}'s {3}!", user.pbThis, trapUser.pbThis(true), trapMove))
  570       user.effects[PBEffects::Trapping]     = 0
  571       user.effects[PBEffects::TrappingMove] = nil
  572       user.effects[PBEffects::TrappingUser] = -1
  573     end
  574     if user.effects[PBEffects::LeechSeed] >= 0
  575       user.effects[PBEffects::LeechSeed] = -1
  576       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} shed Leech Seed!", user.pbThis))
  577     end
  578     if user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::StealthRock]
  579       user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::StealthRock] = false
  580       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} blew away stealth rocks!", user.pbThis))
  581     end
  582     if user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Spikes] > 0
  583       user.pbOwnSide.effects[PBEffects::Spikes] = 0
  584       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} blew away spikes!", user.pbThis))

  601 #===============================================================================
  602 # Attacks 2 rounds in the future. (Doom Desire, Future Sight)
  603 #===============================================================================
  604 class Battle::Move::AttackTwoTurnsLater < Battle::Move
  605   def targetsPosition?; return true; end
  606 
  607   # Stops damage being dealt in the setting-up turn.
  608   def pbDamagingMove?
  609     return false if !@battle.futureSight
  610     return super
  611   end
  612 
  613   def pbAccuracyCheck(user, target)
  614     return true if !@battle.futureSight
  615     return super
  616   end
  617 
  618   def pbDisplayUseMessage(user)
  619     super if !@battle.futureSight
  620   end
  621 
  622   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
  623     if !@battle.futureSight &&
  624        @battle.positions[target.index].effects[PBEffects::FutureSightCounter] > 0
  625       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!")) if show_message
  626       return true
  627     end
  628     return false
  629   end
  630 
  631   def pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, target)
  632     return if @battle.futureSight   # Attack is hitting
  633     effects = @battle.positions[target.index].effects
  634     effects[PBEffects::FutureSightCounter]        = 3
  635     effects[PBEffects::FutureSightMove]           = @id
  636     effects[PBEffects::FutureSightUserIndex]      = user.index
  637     effects[PBEffects::FutureSightUserPartyIndex] = user.pokemonIndex
  638     if @id == :DOOMDESIRE
  639       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} chose Doom Desire as its destiny!", user.pbThis))
  640     else
  641       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} foresaw an attack!", user.pbThis))
  642     end
